sloka: ततो भ्रातरमासीनं कुम्भकर्णो ऽब्रवीद्वचः ।निद्रा मां बाधते राजन्कारयस्व ममालयम् ।। ७.१३.२ ॥
transliteration: tato bhrātaramāsīnaṁ kumbhakarṇo 'bravīdvacaḥ ।nidrā māṁ bādhate rājankārayasva mamālayam ।। 7.13.2 ॥

translations.english: Then, Kumbhakarna spoke to his seated brother, saying, "O King, sleep afflicts me; please have a dwelling built for me."
